steps.name: Shining
steps.text: W, perhaps you could drive a little slower.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Our tragically wounded Dame won't hang in there much longer, Shining.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hold on tight, everybody. Incline ahead.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: A ride this rough likely won't benefit Kal'tsit's recovery in any way.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So what? Theresis couldn't hack her to death. You think a little bad suspension's gonna be what does it?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Whew, the roads here suck. Passing through a bomb crater, guys.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You could steer around.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Too late, I'm going in.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Menacing growl)

steps.name: W
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, Kal'tsit Jr. Now get your claws off me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're free to screw off of the car and drag your sorry little master behind us. Your choice.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (High-pitched braying)

steps.name: W
steps.text: Got something ticking in your metal skull? You can try it, I'll play ball with you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Or maybe, I should just throw you off and make roadkill out of you.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: W, we're in a hurry.

steps.name: W
steps.text: This hag can't cough a single word at anyone right now, and look at how sad and distressed her stupid wimpy pet is! I've never felt this good in my life!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't you wanna get payback on your boss? Medical Department shit-stirrer Kal'tsit, reduced to THIS!!!

spans.text: Don't you wanna get payback on your boss? Medical Department shit-stirrer Kal'tsit, reduced to

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: She is my patient now.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ugh. You're boring as ever.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Tell Closure and her circus troupe to follow our route. With the dukes and the Sarkaz duking it out, I'm the only one who still knows where to find an opening.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You're very familiar with the terrain and situation.

steps.name: W
steps.text: How do you think I survived the past few years? What, did you picture me swimming in Londinium's sewers?

steps.name: W
steps.text: A merc's got her ways.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Once we're through these ruins, we'll hit our destination.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Is she already there?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You've got my word. I never miss the chance to make someone owe me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But pushing the wheelchair's not on your base plan. I get an extra favor for that.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...Fine.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh yeah, what's the deal between you and the hag? Dragging an incap into Londinium's a pretty terrible idea.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: She is my...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: No. I am her sin.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...A comms station?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We need to broadcast our existence out there.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Right on the money, Doctor of Rhodes Island.

options: The dukes need to know about this.
If none act, it gives any other dukes fodder against them.
When the crown's vacant, everyone will want to be airtight.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: You know Victoria better than I imagined.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Where can we find a comms station?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: The signal hub for this place got wrecked by the Sarkaz right off the bat, but I know of a small station we might still be able to use.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It's in a pub. Best house in all of Londinium before Norport went to pot.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: They set up a signal transceiver with mad high power in there, so they could get ahead of what their guests from all over wanted.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It looks like stones fell and blocked up the whole outside of it, but if we can find a way in, and use the gear that's still left in there, then I think we...

spans.text: It looks like stones fell and blocked up the whole outside of it, but if we
find a way in, and use the gear that's still left in there, then I think we...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: It'll be an extremely dangerous op. Going by what you've told us, we're in luck if that sorry station still works, after which we couldn't even encrypt the outgoing signal.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Bang on. It's an old civilian model.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: No matter who hears, they'll know what we're trying to say in a flash.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: And the Sarkaz will immediately act.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We've just got to gamble on the dukes not wanting a preventable massacre to their name.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Besides, I'm trusting... some duke or other will want to step up proper. After all, they're not going to want a Victoria in ruins themselves.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The Duke of Windermere, for example?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: She could be one of them, yeah.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Interesting. Looks like you do read plenty of newspapers, Delphine.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Doctor, Amiya, I believe this plan is feasible. We need to inject a little chaos to shatter the deadlock.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: One or more dukes on the offensive can be a smokescreen for us, whether it's finding where that airship is located, or creating conditions for the people to evacuate their abandoned plate.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Then before we do, we need to put an end to the pointless infighting and cutthroat slaughter in this lockdown zone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We need to give them a reason to reunite.

options: Letting everyone know hope still exists, for example.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we can make headway on that, and distribute the remaining resources here to those who need them most... then maybe we can hold out for even longer.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rebuilding broken trust, just like you said.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmph. Real or fake, hope is still hope anyhow.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: So. That's your genius plan? Go to an old pub for an old comms station, and beg the dukes outside to save us because we're all dead meat in here?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Incredible. I might want to applaud you lot.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: If you have any good ideas, you can give them right now, Cador.

spans.text: If you have any good ideas, you can give them

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Aside from charging past the Sarkaz blockade walls.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Just didn't think after becoming thieves and conmen, we'd finally be grovelling on the ground to all those snot-nosed blue-blood boys and girls.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: If you don't like the idea of it being a mayday, you can think of it as a wager instead.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Oh, look, what an elite word, 'wager!' Oh, we're off making a wager with the people in their castles now, lucky us!

spans.text: Oh, look, what an elite word, 'wager!' Oh, we're off making a
with the people in their castles now, lucky us!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: And you can choose to keep robbing people in the street. I won't stop you.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Pick what you want to talk about!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Cador, I know you care about your 'dignity' like nothing else, but NOW IS NOT THE TIME FOR IT.

spans.text: Cador, I know you care about your 'dignity' like nothing else, but
NOW IS NOT THE TIME FOR IT.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: If the dukes attacking can help us, then inviting them is an option.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Alright. You thought of the consequences?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: The dukes help us. Bang-up. Then what?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: We hop on their warships to march for our great Londinium? Or do we become their subjects, sticking ourselves in Caster or Wellington's factories to feed ourselves to lathing machines?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: This is not going to do us bloody favors. We are about to sell our lives to the BLOODY NOBLES!

spans.text: This is not going to do us bloody favors. We are about to sell our lives to the

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Say goodbye to being Berties anymore, we'll be asylum-seekers for them to snuff out as they feel!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: AND WE AREN'T RIGHT NOW?!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: CADOR! DO YOU THINK WE'RE THE FREE AND HAPPY PEOPLE OF NORPORT RIGHT NOW?!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: WAR BROKE OUT! WE'RE IN THE MIDDLE OF IT!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Do—Do you want to tell me that you think once a hero descends from the sky to guide all Porties together with you to crush the Sarkaz outside, just like you've been dreaming—

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: —that everything can return to how it was?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: 'Dignity!' Look at us, Cador!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We know... full well, what the hell we've done!

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Shit. What's happening?!

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: In the street! They're all armed!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Okay, no panic. We need to clear this up—

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Do they not want to live anymore? Who still has the strength to scrap this hard?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Every gang sheltering in Norbert should be in the same boat as us in terms of low supplies—
Through the boarded-up window, all that can be seen is still-live smoke.
Then hollering and cursing, coupled with crying and begging. The sort of thing they've had to tune out these days. Blind eye, deaf ear.
But this time, it's not brief clamor from a dingy alleyway. It's not following nervousness or hesitation, or any attempt at cover or disguise.

Within the smoke, a luggage trolley nonchalantly rolls down the street, very well the previous property of some inn, a past life of conveying suitcases big and small belonging to guests from all corners.
Now, pushed out amidst the dust by the explosion's aftermath, it becomes the focal point where everyone's gazes gather—the target of all their ardent desires.
Atop that trolley is a stack of supplies full to bursting. Box upon box of tin cans, clean water, rations rough yet oh so sweet...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: That's...
Her voice fails and falters. She finds herself... unable to avert her eyes.

steps.name: Desperate Thug
steps.text: I... I need this food! Get lost!

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: You get lost! God's sakes, I don't need you here! You can't eat that much!

steps.name: Desperate Thug
steps.text: You can split a bit with me, come on, just a few rolls of bread'll do...

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: Take your hands off the stuff first!
The crowds are quarreling, ripping and tearing, the luggage freewheeling from one group's hands to another's.
People fall, climb back up, throw themselves at their mountain of hopes, each with a wish to get their share from it.
But most end up empty-handed.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Bloody hell! Where'd all that shit even come from?!

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Half an hour more and they'll be killing all their own!

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Hey, stop! Stop!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Stay back. For now.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: They won't hear what you're saying. We can't...
Baird notices a silhouette slip past her.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Siege!
Siege's hammer smashes fiercely against the ground, the turbulence blowing away the dust and stench of blood throughout the street.
She takes in the people before her, and they give her death stares back.

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: Siege...

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: What are you here for? What are you doing?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I recognize you. LJ. Your three brats doing alright?

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: Hahahahahah. Alright?

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: We can find out once we see them. Just die first. Or maybe I will.

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: It's fine for them. They're free. No need to fight over scraps like the brutes we are. They died a clean and honest death.

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: So, Siege? Gonna be a saint, send me to see them?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We don't have to do this. There's no point going knives out at our own neighbors here.

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: There's all the point.

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: It's the point and then some, Siege. A roll of bread means I live through tonight. If my luck's good, tomorrow night too.

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: Aren't you hungry? Aren't you parched? Do you even have the energy to choose?

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: 'Cause that tells me it hasn't tormented you enough. You're not even part of this.

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: Give me an answer, Siege, why don't you. How much hope are you looking to steal from me?

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: I could never beat you before. But now, I can—

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: Uwgh—graagh—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, stop! Sir!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're not casting, you're destroying your own body! Your increased Arts Assimilation is just a pathological result of acute infection!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can help you! Please stop!

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: Shove off, shove off! You self-respecting do-gooders! Either go back and hide in your houses, or join the bloody fight!

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: Everyone wants to survive, and this is the most reliable method I know.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Shit, LJ! You want me to pound you flat that badly?!

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Alright, I—

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Save it! God's sakes, enough!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Her Royal Highness Alexandrina Vina Victoria is here!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Morgan!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Progeny of the Aslan King, Her Royal Highness Alexandrina Vina Victoria, has brought back the Sighs of Kings!

steps.name: Desperate Thug
steps.text: Victoria... Siege, your surname was Victoria?!

steps.name: Desperate Thug
steps.text: That sword's... the Sighs of Kings?

steps.name: Desperate Thug
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Desperate Thug
steps.text: Well, I always suspected... you weren't an ordinary Feline.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Per Her Royal Highness's demands, the dukes' forces have begun to advance their way here.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Those Sarkaz won't hold them off, even if they throw in the ship! We're saved now!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Delphine, even you're...

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Her Royal Highness?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Siege... you were bloody royal family?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Hahahah...

steps.name: Desperate Thug
steps.text: The dukes, they're finally—

steps.name: Desperate Thug
steps.text: Siege... no, Your Royal Highness Alexandrina, I have to...

steps.name: Worked-Up Thug
steps.text: Rgghh—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Acute Oripathy symptoms.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll prep an inhibitor injection straight away. He's in terrible condition.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You see, we have medicine too! We just need to hold on a little longer—

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: That's right, just a little longer now.
